symptom: A hand-written MCP listen_url without its scheme (127.0.0.1:8080) made settings validation throw "Invalid URL", because zod still ran the loopback refinement after .url() failed. Settings resolution and the MCP registry stopped instead of dropping that one server with a warning.
rule: A validator never throws on input an earlier check rejected; test refusals with realistic typos (principle 13).
check: pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts apps/desktop/src/engine/settings/__tests__/schema.test.ts -t 'listen_url is not a URL'
